<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 183.045 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.038 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 intensity) suggests about 8–9 carbons. The formula that best matches this exact mass with only C, H, and O atoms is C₈H₆O₅ (exact mass 182.0215 Da), which is within a reasonable error range for the measurement. No other common heteroatoms improve the fit without introducing implausible compositions. Therefore, the most likely molecular formula is C8H6O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H6O5</final_answer>
